title: Multi-year collision trend explainers (aggregate)
context: The collision-018 task delivers a single-period hotspot view. Multi-year trend analysis of STATS19 data can help journalists and community groups understand whether road safety is changing in an area — but requires the same aggregate-only / k>=5 / no-causation guardrails applied across multiple annual extracts. No year-on-year bin with fewer than k=5 events may appear in output, and no trend may be labelled as a causal improvement or worsening.
objective: Build multi-year collision trend explainers for at least one area (STATS19 data, aggregate-only, k>=5 minimum cell count across all years), extending the collision-018 module.
acceptanceCriteria: Gate-003 PASS: STATS19 OGL v3; output CC-BY-4.0 with OGL attribution; aggregate-only; k >= 5 minimum cell count per geo/temporal bin across all years; no person-level rows; no re-identification.

Methodology Card: multi-year trend methodology documented; appropriate denominators and exposure metrics used; noise and confidence limits acknowledged; no causation, no 'road getting better/worse' causal labelling.
Harm scan passed (no blame/stigma/community targeting); Domain (road-safety) + Methodology+Stats reviewer sign-offs obtained.
Figures reproduce in CI from committed code + STATS19 multi-year snapshots; built on the shared toolkit (toolkit-002) and the collision-018 module.
License reviewer and Accessibility reviewer sign-offs obtained.
output: Multi-year collision trend explainers for at least one area (committed static tool + plain-language content + Methodology Card + gate artifact + harm-scan record + accessibility sign-off).
